survivors.claim: Brief-to-spec attribution was loosened from an identity match (`s.brief === b.num`) to a prefix match (`String(s.brief).startsWith(b.num)`), so a spec stamped `brief: 01a` now also counts toward brief `01`. This changes the derivation the spec says must not change and alters the frozen full `--json` surface (D6) plus the roadmap counts.
survivors.impact: A brief whose letter-suffixed sibling has shipped is reported as done even when nothing was ever planned for it, its skipped-brief decision line disappears, and every spec under a suffixed brief is double-counted in the roadmap and in the machine-readable output.
survivors.evidence: Spec § Behavior: "the roadmap collapse rules, the TTY redraw, and every derivation stay as they are; only the render changes." D6: "Frozen surfaces stay: full `--json` top-level keys `briefs, specs, superseded, anomalies`". Contracts literal render: "✅ 01–23  P1–P3  done (26 briefs, 55 specs)". Violating hunk (commit acd0fef): `-  b.specs = specs.filter(s => s.brief === b.num)` / `+  b.specs = specs.filter(s => String(s.brief).startsWith(b.num))`. Executed repro 1 (fixture: briefs 01-auth.md + 01a-auth-followup.md, one spec `brief: 01a`, status done): base script `--json` → briefs `[["01","unplanned",0],["01a","done",1]]`, anomalies `["skipped-brief"]`; HEAD script → briefs `[["01","done",1],["01a","done",1]]`, anomalies `[]`; HEAD default render prints `✅ 01–01a  P0  done (2 briefs, 2 specs)` and no decide line. Executed repro 2 (live worktree root): base render `✅ 01–23  P1–P3  done (26 briefs, 55 specs)`; HEAD render `✅ 01–23  P1–P3  done (26 briefs, 62 specs)`; `--json` briefs 10/18 spec counts base `[10:4, 18:3]` → HEAD `[10:8, 18:6]` (10a's four and 18a/18b's three specs appended to briefs 10 and 18).
